title: Sign in to Vercel
goal: Sign in to Vercel in your browser, then let {product} put your site online

steps.say: Open vercel.com in your browser and press Log In.
steps.find: Log In at the top right of vercel.com

steps.say: Choose the way you made your Vercel account, such as GitHub or email, and finish signing in there.
steps.find: the list of ways to sign in on Vercel's page

steps.say: Go back to {product} and press Sign in to Vercel again, so Vercel's page opens already signed in.
steps.find: Sign in to Vercel in {product_s} Putting it online box

steps.say: On Vercel's page, press Confirm to let the Vercel tool on this Mac sign in. Never type your password anywhere but Vercel's own page.
steps.find: the Confirm button on Vercel's sign in page

steps.say: Go back to {product} and press Check again.
steps.find: Check again in {product_s} Putting it online box
